personal_years.title: THE YEAR OF BEGINNING
positive_outcomes: Year full of growth financially, professionally, and personally
New ideas and opportunities come your way
New relationships or new phases in existing ones (like marriage)
Promising year for job changes, launching new ventures, or business expansion
Meet new individuals and form rewarding connections
Ideal time to develop new habits or cultivate new qualities
Ventures bear fruit with successful completions
High energy across all facets of life
Robust willpower and unique energy throughout the year
negative_impacts: Surge in energy may make you appear egotistic, arrogant, and aggressive
Impatience leading to potentially reckless behaviour
Exhaustion from hard work; need for adequate rest
May become distrustful
If Psychic Number is 8, may face health issues related to stomach or feet
If Psychic Number is 5, year could be particularly favourable

personal_years.title: THE YEAR OF COOPERATION
positive_outcomes: Emphasis on family and friends; dedicate quality time to them
Quiet and gentle year allowing cherished moments with loved ones
Generously spend time and money on family and friends
Ideal time to conclude old ventures and endeavours
May become more diplomatic to avoid misunderstandings and conflicts
negative_impacts: Representation of the Moon may bring mood swings
May become nervous and emotional
Headaches, doubts, worries leading to anxiety
Imbalance in a few areas of life
Not ideal for starting new businesses or initiatives

personal_years.title: THE YEAR OF JOY AND EXPANSIONS
positive_outcomes: Socialize more than previous eight years
Social openness is key to success
Enjoy humor and develop better sense of humor
Reconnect with old friends
Numerous travel opportunities
May entertain others like a performer at social gatherings
Opportunities to learn new things or enhance knowledge
negative_impacts: Ego may follow knowledge and confidence; needs to be kept in check
Surges of energy may make you feel uncontrolled or scattered
Possibility of gossiping and indulging in it
Increased spending due to socializing, travel, and reconnections

positive_outcomes: Introduction of practicality into life
Sense of security; seek to secure new financial resources and future assets
Encourages establishment of routine and discipline
Growth proportional to discipline and routine
negative_impacts: First two months may be confusing and hard to decide best approach
Less time for extracurricular activities or socializing
Exhaustion leading to low energy levels; need adequate sleep
Additional responsibilities leading to pressure and frustration
Days may seem tough and slow-paced
No escaping from hard work; less reliance on fate advised

Fortuitous for planning to conceive
Opportunities for enjoyment and fun activities
Career opportunities: promotion, new job, or business venture

Increased sense of freedom
negative_impacts: No significant negative impacts
